details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1464-1465 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The fallback call passes the temp file path as the first argument to `gh_retry`, which these reviewers say is the wrong helper signature.
  WHY: Reported as critical by minimax and x-ai, but deepseek/qwen/z-ai explicitly rejected the claim by pointing to the inline `gh_retry` that accepts an output file first.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457-1482 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback loop can issue an unbounded number of `gh api` lookups for distinct closing references in the PR body.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers warned this can burn API quota and/or extend the step until timeout; the highest reported severity was medium.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457-1458 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `${{ github.repository }}` is interpolated into the PCRE regex without escaping metacharacters.
  WHY: Repo names containing regex operators like `.` can cause false matches and route unrelated issue numbers into the fallback lookup.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457-1458 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The URL prefix in the grep pattern is not constrained to `github.com`.
  WHY: URLs on other hosts that contain the same `owner/repo/issues/N` path can be treated as in-repo references even though the comment says the prefix is restricted to the current repository.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1447-1453 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The body-text fallback only runs when the GraphQL result is exactly `[]`.
  WHY: If GraphQL returns a non-empty but incomplete linked-issues array, missing body references are never back-filled.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1463-1478 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_fb_issue_tmp` is only removed on the normal loop exit path and has no EXIT trap.
  WHY: An early cancel or abort can orphan the temp file before `rm -f` runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1469-1475 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `jq --argjson` can fail and fall back to the previous `_fallback_json` value without surfacing an error.
  WHY: A malformed `_fb_issue_obj` would be dropped from the accumulated context silently.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1480 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The resolved-count log line depends on a subshell `jq 'length'` evaluation.
  WHY: If that pipeline fails, the status message can be misleading even though `_linked_context_raw` has already been set.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1461 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The fallback relies on `grep -P` being available.
  WHY: On environments without GNU PCRE grep, the extraction fails and the `|| true` hides the problem, leaving the fallback empty.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `${{ github.repository }}` is interpolated into the PCRE regex without escaping metacharacters.
  WHY: Repo names containing `.` can overmatch and pull unrelated issue URLs into the fallback lookup.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1458-1482 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: There is no upper bound on the number of issues fetched from `_fallback_numbers`.
  WHY: A PR body with many closing references can trigger a large number of sequential `gh api` calls and consume rate limit budget.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1466-1478 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `_fb_issue_tmp` is created with `mktemp` and removed with `rm -f` only on the normal path.
  WHY: An early termination can leave temporary files behind until the runner is discarded.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1447 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The body-text fallback only activates when GraphQL returns exactly `[]`.
  WHY: A non-empty but incomplete GraphQL result will skip back-filling missing references from the PR body.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1469-1475 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: If `_fb_issue_obj` is non-empty but not valid JSON, the `jq --argjson` append falls back to the previous `_fallback_json` value.
  WHY: That issue would be silently dropped from the accumulated fallback context.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1480 | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The log message computes the resolved count with an inline `jq 'length'`.
  WHY: If that subshell/pipeline fails, the status text can become misleading even though the context was already assembled.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1464 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The code uses `gh_retry` with a temp file path as the first argument, but `gh_retry` does not accept an output file parameter.
  WHY: The temp file path is interpreted as a command, so the fallback loop will fail at runtime for every issue number.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457-1482 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback loop iterates over all issue numbers extracted from the PR body with no upper bound.
  WHY: Many closing references can trigger many API calls and risk rate-limit exhaustion or workflow timeout.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1457 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `${{ github.repository }}` is interpolated directly into the PCRE regex without escaping metacharacters.
  WHY: Repository names containing `.` or similar characters can produce false matches.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1463-1477 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The temporary file created for each issue lookup is only removed on the normal exit path.
  WHY: A cancellation or failure between `mktemp` and `rm -f` can orphan the temp file.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1453 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback only triggers when GraphQL returns exactly `[]`.
  WHY: If GraphQL returns a partial linked-issues array, missing body references are never back-filled.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1460-1477 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback loop has no cap on the number of API calls.
  WHY: A PR body with many closing references can make that many sequential REST API calls and exhaust rate limits or time out.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1458 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${{ github.repository }}` is interpolated unescaped into the PCRE regex.
  WHY: Repository names containing regex metacharacters can be interpreted as regex wildcards and cause false matches.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1466, 1476 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Temporary file cleanup only occurs on the normal exit path.
  WHY: There is no trap to ensure cleanup if the step is cancelled or fails between `mktemp` and `rm -f`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1453 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback only triggers when GraphQL returns exactly `[]`.
  WHY: If GraphQL returns a partial/incomplete linked-issues array, missing references are never back-filled.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1458 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The URL pattern in the grep regex is not constrained to `github.com`.
  WHY: Any host matching the repo-path pattern can be extracted and looked up in the target repo.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The fallback only fires when GraphQL returns exactly `[]`.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1466-1476 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `rm -f` only runs on the success path after the API call.

- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1471-1475 | confidence=3
